hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run --quiet peer-cc init >/dev/null 2>&1; uv run --quiet peer-cc register --role coordinator --id A >/dev/null 2>&1; case $? in 0) echo 'peer-cc: registered as coordinator A';; 3) echo 'peer-cc: COORDINATOR COLLISION — another A is already alive in this session. This CC will NOT take over. Either close the other A, or wipe the session with: uv run peer-cc reset --yes';; *) echo 'peer-cc: register failed (unknown error)';; esac
